# Climate package search: results

*Generated by `index/tools/climate-portfolio/packages.py`; do not edit by hand. Read with [climate-portfolio-allocation.md](climate-portfolio-allocation.md). Lever definitions: `index/tools/climate-portfolio/packages.json`.*

**What this is.** Every combination of 11 levers (13,824 packages) run on the carbon model's decided package with identical physical assumptions. "Outlays" are changes in general-fund climate outlays against the decided package (credits, grid and nuclear programs, the model's industrial-support estimate and named external costs), constant 2025 dollars, 2030-39. Fee, methane and CES receipts are channel money and are shown separately, not netted. Tons are net greenhouse gases avoided against the decided package, 2030-50. Bills are the average residential bill. Packages are not scores, and the model is one structural model, conservative in its first decade.

## Levers

- **Clean-energy credits (CLI-1A)** (`credits`): `keep` Keep as decided; `bridge` Bridge: vehicle credits end after 2034; wind/solar credits phase out once power CO2 falls below 600 Mt (decided: 383 Mt); `targeted` Targeted bridge: as bridge, with the new-EV credit halved (income and price caps); `standard_led` Standard-led: new-EV and truck credits end after 2032 as the statutory sales standard binds (EV credit halved until then); wind/solar phase-out at 600 Mt
- **Clean electricity standard (CLI-3)** (`ces`): `80by35` 80% by 2035 (decided); `90by35` CLI-3E: 90% by 2035, ACP $60/MWh; `90by35_100by40` CLI-3E/4D: 90% by 2035 and 100% by 2040 (statutory cap backstop), ACP $80/MWh
- **Vehicle standards in statute (CLI-4E)** (`zev`): `decided` CLI-4A rules as modeled (25% EV sales 2032, 50% 2037, 100% by 2050); `cars` CLI-4E cars: zero-emission sales 45% 2030, 85% 2035, 100% 2040; `cars_trucks` CLI-4E cars plus a heavy-truck schedule (10% 2032, 30% 2035, 65% 2040, 90% 2045; ASSUMED)
- **Carbon price path** (`price`): `decided` Decided: D7's steps to 2032, then $150 by 2037 (Espen, Oct 26; now in carbon-parameters.csv); `old100` Pre-Oct 26 D7 path ($100 by 2037), for comparison
- **Public grid delivery (CLI-10G)** (`grid`): `off` Off; `on` On ($12B a year 2030-39, ASSUMED effect)
- **Low-income heat-pump retrofits (CLI-5W)** (`wx`): `off` 0.25 million homes a year (decided); `on` 0.75 million homes a year
- **Clean-heat standard (proxy: heat-pump cost premium removed from 2032)** (`heat`): `off` Off (decided); `on` Clean-heat standard (floor measure; proxy)
- **Clean-industry support (CLI-9 proxy)** (`industry`): `off` Decided (15% support); `on` Doubled (30%); `high` 50% support (CLI-9 contracts at scale; floor measure)
- **Fee on industrial process CO2 and N2O** (`process`): `off` Off (decided); `on` On (REV-C1 option)
- **Methane fee (REV-C3)** (`methane`): `decided` IRA charge reinstated with certified exemption (decided); `x3` Three times the carbon fee per ton CO2e with coal mines (option)
- **Coal retirement (CLI-11)** (`coal`): `off` Model schedule (4 GW a year); `on` Securitized retirement, all coal out by 2032 (25 GW a year)

## Outside the model: farms, forests and removal (CLI-13)

Farms, forests and carbon removal (CLI-13) are outside the carbon model; these are planning estimates (Mt CO2e a year, 2025 dollars) added only where marked, never to the model rows.

| Item | Mt CO2e a year, 2035 (low / mid / high) | 2050 | Cost 2030-39, $B 2025 | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Conditioned agricultural methane and nitrogen payments (CLI-13) | 30 / 60 / 100 | 60 / 110 / 170 | 10 / 25 / 50 | estimate: enteric, manure and nitrogen practices at about $20-60 per ton on about 250-450 Mt abated over 2030-39; OBBBA moved IRA conservation money into the EQIP/CSP baseline without climate targeting (CRS IF13114) |
| Forests, sink protection and reforestation (CLI-13) | 20 / 50 / 100 | 40 / 90 / 160 | 10 / 20 / 35 | estimate: reforestation and sink protection only; wildfire risk reduction is priced in the disaster package (D5) |
| Federal carbon-removal purchases by reverse auction (CLI-13) | 10 / 25 / 50 | 150 / 300 / 400 | 20 / 45 / 90 | estimate: purchases ramping to about 300 Mt a year by 2045-50; direct air capture projected at $230-540 a ton by 2050 (ETH Zurich 2024), cheaper biomass and mineral routes for part; about 150 Mt bought over 2030-39 at $150-600 a ton; most cost falls after 2039 (roughly $60-120B a year at 300 Mt) |

Together: 60-250 Mt in 2035 (mid 135), about 2.1 points of the 2005 baseline; 250-730 Mt in 2050 (mid 500), about 7.6 points.
